decisions.reason: A door lever handle family sits squarely within the firm's core metal hardware know-how, so the firm can read the market feedback well, and its survival through 2019 while sibling lines were cut suggests it proved itself.
This handle design builds directly on the firm's established design and fabrication expertise and stayed listed after the 2019 portfolio pruning, so management has little reason to drop it now.

The electronic access system with its unique light technology is further from the firm's metal-working base, but it was rebranded and developed further as LightAccess Pro, which shows the firm is building its own knowledge in this area and sees it as a strategic growth field.
